name: Diff Breakdown
description: See a branch's changes broken down by kind: runtime, tests, contracts, DB migrations, CI/CD, config, dependencies and docs, with each kind's share of the changed lines.

settings.title: Compare against
settings.description: Branch or ref to diff against, such as origin/develop. Empty uses the remote's default branch.

settings.title: Auto refresh (seconds)
settings.description: How often the open panel re-reads the changes. 0 refreshes only on workspace switches and the Refresh button.
